question: ‘I, Me, Mine’ is the autobiography of which international musician?
solution:
The correct answer is __**George Harrison.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• "**I Me Mine**" is a song by the English rock band the Beatles from their 1970 album Let It Be.
